summary: Login times out for some users
description: Some users are reporting that they get logged out randomly. Started after the last release. Please fix asap.

comments.author: Priya
comments.body: Mostly happens on mobile Safari from what support is hearing.

comments.author: Dan
comments.body: I think PROJ-130 changed the session cookie to SameSite=Strict, could be related.

comments.author: Priya
comments.body: Also if the fix is risky, a quick workaround for mobile is fine for this sprint, proper fix can be a follow-up.
